List input recordings in a ZIP archive

Source: R/read_archive.R
movie_members.Rd

Some published downloads contain several recordings. Inspect their member names, then pass one as member to read_movie(). ZIP-based emulator formats such as BK2 use their normal extension and format-specific reader.

Usage

movie_members(path)

Arguments

path

ZIP archive path.

Value

Data frame with member, format, and uncompressed byte count.

Examples

# A download that holds two recordings.
archive <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
files <- system.file("extdata", c("sample.fm2", "sample.smv"), package = "replayr")
zip::zip(archive, files, mode = "cherry-pick")
movie_members(archive)
#>       member format bytes
#> 1 sample.fm2    fm2 82945
#> 2 sample.smv    smv  7264
read_movie(archive, member = "sample.smv")
#> <replayr_movie [smv] observations=3600 players=1 buttons=12 source=file17ea1cda52fb.zip>
#> Header keys: version, uid, rerecordCount, ctrlMask, opts, isPal, sync, inputSampleCount, ...
#> P1 active observations: dpad_right=900, dpad_left=900, dpad_down=900, dpad_up=900, start=6, select=4, b=900, a=450, x=288
unlink(archive)
